description: Reasons a person can pick after rating the agent, already translated into their language. Call it once when the widget opens and cache it; re-read when the platform says the dictionary changed, or lazily by the `rev` value. Two lists: `reasons` are the live ones to draw in the window, `retired` are switched off and are only there so old feedback stays readable. If this door is silent, show the free-text field anyway and still count the thumb — never drop a rating.

locale.description: Language of the person, e.g. ru / uk / de-AT. Falls back exact → base → English, never Russian.

name: get_feedback_reasons
title: Feedback reasons
